'''2011 Tatooine Regionals Mark VanDriel DS Invasion''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Mark VanDriel]] at [[2011 Tatooine Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Invasion / In Complete Control|Theed-D-invasion.gif}}
* '''Username:''' MaVanDriel
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.3]]
